svg.text: Release Desk on Grok Bot: every bot-to-bot handover (PID-ER, with PID-NC extras)
Intake sends Lead only intake-request, and that message triggers Lead. Lead is the only writer of pid.state.{requestId} and sends public-status back. Every stage-return and build-result goes to Lead.
Human gates are asked and answered between Vishal and the bot that owns that work. Lead never asks Vishal for an approval and never sets one.
Audit trail: every bot copies Release Desk Log (SendToAgent, priority false) on each handoff.v1 sent or received, each REJECT, each gate ask and human decision; Lead also sends each stage transition
never routes · never approves · flags anomalies
PID-ER · enhancement for an existing customer · Lead chat
PID-NC extras · new customer · Lead chat · dashed = stages that exist only in PID-NC (inserted between steps 3 and 4)
public front door · talks to Lead
public front door · talks to Lead
18 · decision · APPROVE as security = iteration gate
tests fail or Security blocker → back to 20 as stage-handoff · build · remediate (max 3)
38 · HUMAN GATE ask · release-gate go/no-go (Release manager)
41b · chat · status: done, PR ready (info only)
42 · Vishal merges the PR himself (no bot merges)
N1 · chat · start PID-NC (legal name, jurisdiction, sponsor)
N2 · consult · intake, then customer-onboarding (Lead owns)
N12 · HUMAN GATE ask · proposal (Customer sponsor)
✎ then steps 7–19 as PID-ER (finance memo, security sign-off)
✎ writes pid.kickoff naming a future sprint, then steps 20–42
stage-handoff · Lead → work owner (start | remediate | block)
stage-return · owner → Lead (carries the human decision on gate stages)
build-result · Builder → Lead (proposedBranch, prUrl, testsPassed, testsSummary)
consult · ask and answer between teammates; never moves a stage
HUMAN GATE ask · owning bot → Vishal in its own chat
decision · Vishal's verbatim reply; decidedBy = human name
tool call · CloudAgent / GitHub (not a teammate message)
chat with Vishal · trigger, status, his own merge
● cc · <tag> on the Log lane = line appended to {requestId}.jsonl
intake-request · Intake → Lead (the only kind Intake sends)
public-status · Lead → Intake (what the visitor may be told)
